title: NetSuRF M9 estimator-validation measurements
compatibility: Extends v3.1; existing v3.0 and v3.1 readers and bundles remain supported and unchanged.
null_representation: empty CSV field for explicitly nullable values

empirical_bits.csv.sampling: Exact isolated-bit measurements on the recorded sampled population; inclusion_rule and sampling_probability identify selection.

estimator_predictions.csv.semantics: Raw estimator score and an optional signed loss-change prediction. Numerical bit jump is not a signed loss predictor.

ranking_metrics.csv.tie_semantics: Expected recall randomizes selection only within the estimator-score tie at the top-k boundary, conditional on the recorded empirical top-k set. Random expected recall is k/N. Neither is a whole-network claim for sampled candidates.

estimator_runtime.csv.warning: Shared per-example gradient time is repeated for dependent estimator rows and must not be summed.
